```{python}
#| label: code-listing
#| output: asis

import re
from IPython.display import Markdown

# List of files to include
files_to_read = [
    '_download.qmd', '_download_text.qmd',
    '_annotate.qmd', '_annotate_text.qmd',
    'report.qmd'
]

pattern = r'```\{python\}([^`]*)```'

for filename in files_to_read:
    with open(filename, 'r') as f:
        content = f.read()

    blocks = re.findall(pattern, content, re.DOTALL)

    if blocks:
        print(f"## {filename}\n")
        for code in blocks:
            print(f"```{{.python}}\n{code.strip()}\n```\n")
```
